danceStyles.name: Salsa
danceStyles.tagline: The original Latin classic — fast, playful, infinitely connecting.
danceStyles.description: Salsa is the heartbeat of Latin dance — a partner dance born of Cuban Son, Mambo and Puerto Rican rhythms. We teach foundation On1 style as well as the New York On2, in addition to Afro Rumba, Cha-Cha, Boogaloo, Son/Palladium/Classic On2, and Pachanga, building from the ground up so leading and following feel natural rather than memorised.
danceStyles.whoItsFor: If you've never partner-danced before and want one dance that opens every social floor in the world — this is it.

levelOutcomes.foundation: After 8-10 weeks you can lead or follow basic salsa for a full song with any partner.
levelOutcomes.intermediate: Cross-body lead variations, shines, and musicality. You start choosing what to dance, not just remembering steps.
levelOutcomes.advanced: Body movement, layering and full social fluency. You're the partner everyone wants to dance with.

faqs.a: No. We rotate partners in class, which is also the fastest way to learn.

Anything you can move in for attire. Smooth-soled shoes if you have them for the social floor — we don't sell anything. In the classroom, in-studio, we recommend fresh socks for beginners to start out with.

faqs.q: How fit do I need to be?
faqs.a: Not at all. Our oldest student started at 64.

danceStyles.name: Bachata
danceStyles.tagline: Slower, closer, deeply musical. The dance that teaches you to listen.
danceStyles.description: Bachata comes from the Dominican Republic and is the most popular Latin partner dance in the world right now. We teach Modern Bachata - Moderna, with a foundation in the Dominican original. Slower than Salsa — and harder to forget.
danceStyles.whoItsFor: If you want a dance that feels like a conversation, not a performance — start here.

levelOutcomes.foundation: Basic step, side basic, simple turns and the iconic Bachata booty vibe. Enough to dance every song at the social.
levelOutcomes.intermediate: Modern combinations, More complex lead/follow techniques, partner connection drills.
levelOutcomes.advanced: Musicality, different kinds of turns, body movement and isolations, and the freedom to interpret a song as you hear it.

faqs.a: It can be — it can also be playful, joyful, even silly. The dance is what you bring to it.
Most of our Bachata students said the same in week one. Bachata is forgiving by design.

danceStyles.name: West Coast Swing
danceStyles.tagline: Smooth, modern, danced to anything. The improviser's partner dance.
danceStyles.description: West Coast Swing (WCS) is a modern partner dance born in California, known for its smooth, elastic feel and the ability to dance it to almost any song — pop, R&B, blues. It is the partner dance of musicality and improvisation.
danceStyles.whoItsFor: If you want a partner dance you can take to a wedding, a party or a jazz club and still feel right — WCS is it.

levelOutcomes.foundation: Anchor step, push break, sugar push, left-side pass, right-side pass — the whole alphabet of WCS.
levelOutcomes.intermediate: Variations, syncopations, leader/follower hijacks, and your own style begins to emerge.
levelOutcomes.advanced: Full musicality, body language conversation, competition-level connection.

faqs.q: Is WCS only at one of your branches?
faqs.a: Currently yes — Jubilee Hills. Chat with us on WhatsApp and we'll tell you the next batch.

instructors.name: Rishikesh Chhabra
instructors.shortBio:
Rish is first and foremost a Salsa promoter. He took up Ballroom dancing in college while reading Engineering at Assumption University, Thailand — studying under Ajarn Boonbunjong Uratanamanee and Ajarn Thanawat — and was introduced to the languages of the Rumba, Waltz, Tango, Foxtrot and other International Ballroom and Latin styles.

After relocating to Bangalore, a chance encounter with Salsa at a winter workshop at Alliance Francaise sparked a love affair that continues today. There he studied Rueda and Cuban Style under Cyrille Ngalle. Looking to learn LA Style, he found Alex Diaz teaching at a Bangalore club — and from there, there has been no looking back. He joined Furor as a dancer in 2008 and trained as an instructor.

He has taken workshops with Edie ‘Salsa Freak’, Eddie Torres, Dave Paris, Zoe Klein, Junior & Emily, Ricardo Murillo, Viviana Vargas, Juan Matos, Candy Mena, Alex Lee, Kimberly Nodora, and Terry & Cécile — each adding something unique to his journey.

After relocating to Hyderabad, Rish took on the responsibility of promoting Furor's unique blend of Salsa — laying the groundwork for its formal entry by jump-starting weekly Salsa Socials in the city. He brings experience in business, event management and IT to Furor, and manages its online presence alongside his role as Promoter. A poet, writer, musician and dancer, he balances his interests across the arts and sciences. When he's not dancing, he runs PlantDeck - a Landscape Design Build firm he built a decade ago along with his better half.

instructors.name: Mitali Sharma
instructors.shortBio:
Mitali Sharma was a Corporate Senior Manager who transitioned into a full-time career in dance. During her corporate career, she led and trained teams across global markets, developing strong expertise in leadership, structured training, and team building. This foundation naturally translates into her dance instruction, where she emphasizes discipline, clarity, progression, and a supportive learning environment.

She is currently a full-time dancer and instructor at Furor Hyderabad, the oldest and one of the most respected Latin dance schools in Hyderabad and in India. Her Latin dance journey began with Furor and later expanded into seven years of intensive training in the United States.

She trained full-time under internationally acclaimed instructors including Rishikesh Chhabra, Alex Diaz, David Princess, Mariela, Sara Sandoval, and Camilo Forero. I have also been a member of their advanced competition teams, achieving placements at prestigious events such as the Las Vegas Super Congress, Battle of the Next Gen (Miami), Pune International Dance Congress (PIDC), and India International Dance Congress (IIDC).

With over 13 years of comprehensive Latin dance training and competitive experience, she brings both technical depth and performance excellence to her work with students and the team. Over the years, she has earned multiple titles and recognitions. Her goal is to continue contributing meaningfully to the Latin dance community by developing stronger, more confident and technically refined dancers. 

In addition to her role with Furor, Mitali is the creative force and owner behind Fae Dance Studio - a dance and fitness studio in Sainikpuri, Hyderabad.

instructors.name: Swathi Anil
instructors.shortBio:
A part of the Furor family since 2017, Swathi stepped into teaching four years ago and has been bringing energy, precision, and personality to the dance floor ever since. Her classes are known for thoughtful technique breakdowns, engaging drills, and high-energy Afro Cuban warm-ups that challenge both the mind and body.

Passionate about helping students grow with confidence, she creates a space where learning feels rewarding, empowering, and fun. She continues to train under master teachers Rishikesh Chhabra and Alex Diaz, constantly evolving her craft and artistry. Alongside Latin dance, Swathi is also a dedicated Oriental Bellydance practitioner, bringing musicality, expression, and movement depth into her teaching style.

Beyond teaching, she also supports Furor Hyd’s social media presence and creative content for classes and socials, while occasionally stepping behind the console as an aspiring open-floor DJ at La Rumba Latin Party.

Off the dance floor, she works as a Software Manager specialising in strategy and solutioning for packaged applications, blending structure, creativity, and passion in everything she does.

instructors.name: Preetham Medanki
instructors.shortBio:
Preetham Medanki is a Software Engineer by profession and a passionate dancer at heart, whose journey with dance began in childhood. From an early age, he developed a deep love for performing arts, which eventually grew into a lifelong passion and career alongside technology.

With over a decade of experience in the dance industry since 2008, he has performed in numerous television shows, stage productions, and live events, building a strong presence as both a performer and instructor.

As a part-time dance instructor, Preetham specializes in Bollywood, Western, and South Indian Folk dance styles, inspiring students with his energy, creativity, and stage experience. Over the years, he has also trained in multiple dance forms including Bharatanatyam and Hip-Hop, constantly expanding his artistic versatility and love for movement.

Recently, he stepped into the world of Latin dance, beginning his Salsa and Latin dance journey a year ago — adding a fresh new dimension to his evolving dance career.

Balancing the worlds of technology and art, Preetham continues to pursue his passion for dance while thriving in the software industry, proving that creativity and professionalism can go hand in hand.

instructors.name: Surbhi Jain
instructors.shortBio:
Surbhi is a finance professional who has always had a love for dance. Three years ago, she finally stepped into Latin partner dancing at Furor Hyd, where Salsa became her entry point into a world she had long wanted to explore — and it remains her first love to this day.

Training under Rish, she found a teacher whose approach goes beyond just the steps — grounding his students in the history and culture of Latin partner dancing, and making the learning process both structured and meaningful. His guidance over the years has been central to her growth as a dancer, helping her develop a strong foundation and a deeper appreciation for the art form.

She soon went on to learn West Coast Swing as well, and as her confidence in it grew, she began assisting Rish in teaching WCS at Furor Hyd — a natural extension of a journey that has been as much about giving back to the community as it has been about her own growth.

Three years in, Furor remains a space she genuinely values — for the dancing, the learning, and the friendships that have come along the way.

instructors.name: Sudhadhara Panda
instructors.shortBio:
A free spirit, balancing a manager's life by day with a dancers soul by night chasing rhythms, spins, and just the right amount of chaos..The journey from accidental hiphop freestyler 20 years ago to Argentine Tango in 2018, meeting Rish, to training under him for 3 years and performing with team in Mambo and Bachata has been full blown adventure. Along the way, she found a great coach, lifelong friends, and a second family.  

And just when she thought she’d found her groove, she fell head over heels for West Coast Swing recently—a dance that perfectly matches her personality: creative, playful, expressive, and never boring. Because what is life without a little drama?

instructors.name: Venkat K
instructors.shortBio:
Salsa, Bachata, and West Coast Swing Enthusiast. Software Engineer and Yoga Practitioner. Exploring balance through movement, rhythm, and awareness.

In his own words "I began his salsa journey at Furor in late 2022 and have been fortunate to learn under the guidance of Rish, whose passion for Latin dance and emphasis on strong foundations and technique have greatly influenced my growth as a dancer. I am excited to be part of Team Hyderabad, continuing my journey of learning, sharing, and inspiring others through dance."

instructors.name: DJ Ravi Kiran
instructors.shortBio:
DJ Ravi | International DJ (Asia)
Winner – War of DJs, All India DJ Competition 2025
With over 8 years of experience, DJ Ravi has established himself as one of Asia's premier Latin DJs, specializing in Salsa, Bachata, and Kizomba. His deep command of each genre — and the sub-genres within them — allows him to craft seamless, immersive sets that keep dancers moving from the first beat to the last.
What sets DJ Ravi apart is his consistency. Whether headlining weekly socials, guest DJing across India, Vietnam, and Thailand, or commanding the stage at festivals and congresses, he delivers the same hallmark experience: impeccable song selection, masterful transitions, and a dance floor energy that's impossible to ignore.
His credentials speak for themselves — crowned winner at the prestigious War of DJs, an all-India competition held in Goa that brought together the country's top talent.

instructors.name: DJ Aditya
instructors.shortBio:
"If dancing salsa is my meditation, DJing salsa is my nirvana." This is the philosophy that drives DJ Aditya to be the best in the business. He discovered his love for Salsa quite by accident while studying in the USA — being there brought him into direct contact with the Latin population and he came to see their music as a reflection of their culture.

While having the privilege to dance in Indianapolis, Chicago and New York, he realised how varied Salsa music can be — and just how much of a challenge that poses while DJing. "Spinning at socials is a matter of feel. The challenge is getting the crowd to connect to the music. The dancers can be of varied levels and the song has to have something for all of them."

While DJing he impresses on the importance of smoothness in transition and moods in the music. "If asked what the greatest compliment can be to my DJing — I hope dancers feel that my style has flow. I like to think of it as taking the dancers on a journey, with each song beating a new path."

Adi started his DJ journey with Furor Hyderabad in its heydays and once in a while spins whenever he is in town. He's an adjunct faculty member at MICA and spends his time between the two cities Ahmedabad, and Hyderabad.

testimonials.text: Rish is a great teacher — patient, structured and able to explain things three different ways until one clicks. Six months in I'm dancing at every social.
What I love is the systematic approach. Each class builds on the last. And the instructors actually answer messages on WhatsApp at 11pm.
I came in to learn one routine for my sister's wedding. I left in love with dancing. Three years later I'm still here.
Tried two other studios in Hyderabad before Furor. The difference is the social culture — La Rumba is where you stop being a student and start being a dancer.

stories.title: 2nd Runner-up at Chennai Salsa Festival — Kalpana & Karthik
stories.excerpt: Kalpana and Karthik take home second runner-up at the Chennai Salsa Festival open challenge — Hyderabad represents.
stories.body: Our team rolled into Chennai for the Salsa Festival open challenge. Kalpana and Karthik took home second runner-up — a result of months of practice, late-night socials and a partnership that just works. Congratulations to both of them, and to everyone who showed up to cheer.

stories.title: Taste of Salsa — Free Demo & Workshop
stories.excerpt: A free demo for anyone curious about Salsa. No partner needed. No prior dance experience required.
stories.body: Wondering if Salsa is for you? Come to a free Taste of Salsa demo. We'll teach you the basic step, the partner change, and let you dance to one real Salsa song before you decide anything. No partner needed — we rotate. No experience required. Message us on WhatsApp to grab a spot.

stories.title: La Rumba Christmas Ball — 24th December 2022
stories.excerpt: An elegant Christmas Ball. Daytime workshops, evening red-carpet social. The biggest La Rumba of the year.
stories.body: Once a year La Rumba dresses up. The Christmas Ball is daytime workshops followed by an evening red-carpet social. Dress code is elegant. The room is full of dancers from every level. If you've ever wanted to see what your year of training looks like on a real night out — this is it.

stories.title: Social Dancing Etiquette
stories.excerpt: A short guide to surviving — and shining at — your first social. Bright clothes, confidence, and a few things nobody tells you.
stories.body: Your first social is intimidating. Here's what helps: dress brightly so leaders find you, accept dances even when you're nervous, thank your partner at the end, and don't apologise mid-dance — finish the song. The room is much friendlier than it looks. Promise.

stories.title: La Rumba Latin Pool Party — 23rd November 2019
stories.excerpt: Workshops, poolside dancing and a sunset social at Marriott Executive Apartments Gachibowli.
stories.body: Workshops in the afternoon, poolside Salsa and Bachata as the sun went down, and a full social into the night. Marriott Executive Apartments Gachibowli hosted us, and the room was packed with dancers from across the city.

stories.title: Valentine Salsa Workshop — 14th February 2021
stories.excerpt: Two hours of partner dancing as a Valentine's gift — to yourself, or to someone else.
stories.body: A two-hour introduction to partner Salsa, designed for couples and friends who want a different kind of Valentine's evening. No experience needed. Bring a partner or come alone — we rotate.

stories.title: Wow!
stories.excerpt: Wow Magazine covers our Saturday Salsa socials — and the people who make them what they are.
stories.body: Wow Magazine ran a feature on our Saturday Salsa socials. The photographs are by their team and they capture something we struggle to put into words: the moment a beginner stops counting steps and just starts dancing.

stories.title: West Coast Swing Christmas Bootcamp — 24–25 December
stories.excerpt: A 12-hour weekend bootcamp covering the full WCS beginner syllabus. Open level.
stories.body: Twelve hours over two days. Push break, sugar push, side passes, anchor step — the full WCS beginner alphabet, plus enough musicality work that you'll be able to dance every song at our weekly socials by Sunday night. Open level: complete beginners welcome.

intro.headline: Sixteen years. Five cities. One love letter to dance.

introParagraphs: Furor began in 2009 in Bangalore with a single Salsa class. Today we're India's largest Latin dance school — across Bangalore, Hyderabad, Pune, Ahmedabad and Gurgaon — but we've never lost the thing that started it: a room, a song, two people learning to listen, and a social community that emerged from it.
In Hyderabad our home is the Jubilee Hills studio, and our weekly Latin social — La Rumba — is where students stop being students and start being dancers.

intro.headline: The questions we hear most.
intro.lead: Anything missing? WhatsApp us and we'll answer in minutes.

items.q: I have never danced before. Can I still join?
items.a: Yes. Most of our students walk in having never partner-danced before. Our Foundation track is built for absolute beginners — we teach you the basic step, the connection, and the social etiquette from scratch.

items.q: Do I need a partner to join?
items.a: No. We rotate partners in class — it is the fastest way to learn and also how social dancing works. You will dance with leaders and followers of every level.

items.q: What should I wear to class?
items.a: Anything comfortable that lets you move. For the parties Smooth-soled shoes help (you turn easier) but they are not required for your first class - for the studio we recommend fresh socks. Avoid sticky rubber soles if you can.

items.q: How fit do I need to be?
items.a: You do not need to be particularly fit. We teach dancers from age 16 to 70+. Our oldest beginner started at 64.
Foundation batches run for 2 months — typically 20 hours total, with weekend or weekday sessions. Intermediate and Advanced courses follow the same rhythm.
Foundation Salsa and Bachata are ₹6,900 for the full 2-month batch (20 hours). Intermediate courses are ₹4,700 - monthly (16 hours). Pricing is per person, not per couple.

items.q: What if I miss a class?
items.a: We have a flexible make-up policy — message us on WhatsApp and we will find you a session in another batch of the same level.

All Furor Hyderabad Latin beginner batches are at our Jubilee Hills studio — 2nd Floor, Alcazar Mall, Road No. 36, Jubilee Hills, Hyderabad 500033. West Coast Swing beginners are at PUP - also in Jubilee Hills.

items.q: How long has Furor been around?
items.a: Furor was founded in 2009 in Bangalore by Alex Diaz, and opened in Hyderabad in 2010 under Rishikesh Chhabra. Today we are India's largest Latin dance school across Bangalore, Hyderabad, Pune, Ahmedabad and Gurgaon.

La Rumba is our weekly Latin social — Hyderabad's longest-running Salsa and Bachata night. Entry is directly at the Venue - no pre-booking needed. It is where students stop being students and start being dancers.

items.q: Do you do corporate workshops or events?
items.a: Yes. We design dance experiences for corporates, product launches and private events — one-hour workshops up to multi-week programs. WhatsApp us for a custom quote.
WhatsApp is fastest: +91 88860 72572. You can also email furorhyd@dancehyderabad.com or DM @furorhyd on Instagram.

sections.heading: What we collect
sections.body: When you contact us — through our website forms, WhatsApp, Instagram, email or in person — we collect the information you choose to share with us. Typically that is your name, phone number, and the class or batch you are interested in.

sections.heading: How we use it
sections.body: We use your information only to respond to your enquiry, schedule classes, send you class reminders and the occasional update about new batches or socials. We do not sell your data, ever.

sections.heading: Payments
sections.body: Payments are processed by Razorpay. We do not store your card or bank details on our servers — those are held by Razorpay under PCI-DSS-compliant infrastructure.

sections.heading: Cookies and analytics
sections.body: We use basic, privacy-respecting analytics to understand how the site is used (page views, referrers, general device type). We do not track you across other websites and we do not use advertising cookies.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: You can ask us at any time to share, correct or delete the information we have about you. Email furorhyd@dancehyderabad.com or message us on WhatsApp at +91 88860 72572 and we will get to it within 7 working days.

sections.heading: Booking a class
sections.body: A seat in a batch is confirmed only after full payment or a token payment that we have acknowledged on WhatsApp. Without confirmation, seats are not held.

sections.heading: Make-up classes
sections.body: If you miss a class, we offer a flexible make-up policy — message us on WhatsApp and we will find you a session in another batch of the same level, subject to availability. Make-ups are valid for the duration of your current batch.

sections.heading: Refunds
sections.body: Full refunds are available before the batch starts. Once the batch has begun, refunds are pro-rated for the remaining unattended classes and require at least 7 days' notice. Refunds for missed classes that were eligible for a make-up are not available.

sections.heading: Conduct on the floor
sections.body: We expect respectful behaviour on the dance floor and in class — no harassment, no unsolicited advances, no negative coaching of fellow students. Repeat issues will result in removal from class and our weekly socials without refund. We take this seriously.

sections.heading: Photography
sections.body: We occasionally photograph and film classes and socials for our website and social channels. If you would rather not appear in our content, tell any instructor and we will respect that — both at the point of capture and in any later edits you find online.

sections.heading: Injury and risk
sections.body: Partner dancing carries a small risk of injury. By joining a class you confirm that you are physically able to participate, and that any medical conditions we should know about have been disclosed to us.

sections.heading: Changes
